tools.name: mcpScript
tools.description: Run trusted JavaScript that makes multiple MCP tool calls in one request — loop, filter, chain, or fan out between calls. For a single MCP call, search, describe, status check, or auth action, use the mcp tool instead. Discover with await tools.search({ query }) — resolves to { items: [{ path, name, server, description? }], total, hasMore, nextOffset }, not an { ok, data } envelope. Inspect with await tools.describe({ path }) — resolves to the tool descriptor with inputTypeScript, or { path, error: { code, message, suggestions } }. Then call tools.call(path, args) — resolves to { ok: true, data } or { ok: false, error: { code, message } } — or use direct flat calls when the name is already known; use emit(value) for user-visible output. Load the mcp-scripting skill for the full workflow guide.

code.description: Trusted JavaScript MCP script. Use tools.<prefixedToolName>(args) and emit(value).

tools.name: mcp
tools.description:
MCP gateway — server status, tool search/describe, auth, and single MCP tool calls. When one request needs several MCP calls with logic between them, use mcpScript. Non-MCP Pi tools should be called directly, not through mcp.

Usage:
  mcp({ })                              → Show server status and tool counts
  mcp({ server: "name" })               → List tools from server
  mcp({ search: "query" })              → Search MCP tools by name/description
  mcp({ describe: "tool_name" })        → Show tool details and parameters
  mcp({ instructions: "name" })         → Show full server usage instructions
  mcp({ connect: "server-name" })       → Connect to a server and refresh metadata
  mcp({ tool: "name", args: { key: "value" } })         → Call a tool (object args; JSON string also accepted; "arguments" is an alias for "args")
  mcp({ action: "ui-messages" })        → Retrieve accumulated messages from completed UI sessions
  mcp({ action: "auth-start", server: "name" })      → Start manual OAuth and get a browser URL
  mcp({ action: "auth-complete", server: "name", args: { redirectUrl: "..." } }) → Complete manual OAuth
  mcp({ action: "reload" })            → Re-read the watched config and restart the adapter to apply post-startup changes

Mode: action > tool (call) > connect > describe > instructions > search > server (list) > nothing (status)

args.description: Tool arguments as a JSON object, or as a JSON string encoding one

anyOf.description: Alias for `args` — arguments as a JSON string
Alias for `args` — arguments as a JSON object

arguments.description: Alias for `args`, accepted for MCP clients/agents that emit the outer field name `arguments`

connect.description: Server name to connect (lazy connect + metadata refresh)

instructions.description: Server name to show that server's usage instructions

regex.description: Treat search as regex (default: substring match)

includeSchemas.description: Include parameter schemas in search results (default: true)

server.description: Filter to specific server (also disambiguates tool calls)

action.description: Action: 'ui-messages', 'auth-start', 'auth-complete', or 'reload' (re-read the watched config and restart the adapter to apply servers registered after startup)
